positive_cases.name: javascript_protocol
positive_cases.scenario: HTML application host invoked with an inline javascript protocol placeholder.
positive_cases.rationale: Image and protocol selections both match.

positive_cases.name: vbscript_protocol
positive_cases.scenario: HTML application host invoked with an inline vbscript protocol placeholder.
positive_cases.rationale: Image and protocol selections both match.

negative_cases.name: local_hta_file
negative_cases.scenario: HTML application host opening a local application file.
negative_cases.rationale: Image matches but no inline script protocol is present.

negative_cases.name: browser_protocol_argument
negative_cases.scenario: Browser started with a protocol argument.
negative_cases.rationale: Protocol text matches but the image is not the script host.

negative_cases.name: unrelated_system_binary
negative_cases.scenario: System utility executed with ordinary arguments.

notes: All events are synthetic. Negative cases are deliberate near misses that exercise one failing selection each.
